samples.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: square photographic menu image for Rocco's Pizza, a local UK takeaway. True photorealistic professional food photography with believable baked textures, natural imperfections and appetising but realistic portions. No lettering, labels, watermark, people, hands, illustration, CGI appearance or extra food props. Single individual image, not a collage. Subject: one whole stone-baked Pepperoni pizza with tomato sauce, melted mozzarella and a generous double portion of pepperoni, matching the actual menu. Golden moderately risen crust with small charred patches, naturally browned cheese and curled pepperoni edges. No herbs, basil, vegetables, honey or extra toppings. Keep the entire pizza in frame with clear margin, filling roughly 78 percent of the square. Style A: clean, bright menu catalogue photograph. Perfectly overhead 90-degree view. Pizza resting directly on seamless warm ivory background with subtle realistic contact shadow. Broad soft daylight from upper left, neutral white balance, crisp detail across the food, restrained saturation. Minimal, premium and immediately legible at thumbnail size. No plate, tray, board or packaging.
